nodes.label: IL6
props: B-cell stimulatory factor 2; CTL differentiation factor; Hybridoma growth factor; Interferon beta-2

Cytokine with a wide variety of biological functions in immunity, tissue regeneration, and metabolism. Binds to IL6R, then the complex associates to the signaling subunit IL6ST/gp130 to trigger the intracellular IL6-signaling pathway (Probable).

nodes.label: IL6R
props: Part of the receptor for interleukin 6. Binds to IL6 with low affinity, but does not transduce a signal.

references.title: Biomarker of extracellular matrix remodelling C1M and proinflammatory cytokine interleukin 6 are related to synovitis and pain in end-stage knee osteoarthritis patients.
references.note: human end-stage knee OA: synovial fluid IL-6 (not plasma IL-6) associated with pain and synovitis, so IL-6 is present and acts in the OA joint

references.title: sgp130Fc alleviates cartilage degeneration and knee osteoarthritis by inhibiting IL-6 trans-signaling pathway.
references.note: human OA synovial fluid (ELISA) plus rat Hulth OA: IL-6, soluble IL-6R and soluble gp130 all rise with OA stage, and the IL-6/sIL-6R route (trans-signalling) drives the disease (cartilage, not neurons)

references.title: Hexameric structure and assembly of the interleukin-6/IL-6 alpha-receptor/gp130 complex.
references.note: crystal structure of the human IL-6/IL-6Ralpha/gp130 complex: IL-6 binds IL-6Ralpha first, as the block draws it

references.title: Interleukin-6 triggers the association of its receptor with a possible signal transducer, gp130.
references.note: human IL-6R: the 80 kDa IL-6R binds IL-6, and a soluble IL-6R without transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains still binds IL-6 and works

references.title: Interleukin-6 in combination with its soluble IL-6 receptor sensitises rat skin nociceptors to heat, in vivo.
references.note: rat skin nociceptors in vivo: IL-6 only together with its soluble receptor sensitises nociceptors to heat, and nociceptors carry gp130 but little membrane IL-6R

references.title: Interleukin-6 signaling mediates cartilage degradation and pain in posttraumatic osteoarthritis in a sex-specific manner.
references.note: mouse DMM OA: deleting Il6 reduces OA pain, knee innervation and nociceptive signalling, with less STAT3 and ERK activation in the knee and in the dorsal root ganglia - IL-6 receptor signalling in the OA nociceptor

references.title: sgp130Fc alleviates cartilage degeneration and knee osteoarthritis by inhibiting IL-6 trans-signaling pathway.
references.note: rat Hulth OA plus human OA synovial fluid: soluble gp130-Fc, which traps the IL-6:sIL-6R pair, blocks the effects of the complex, showing gp130 as its receptor in OA (cartilage, not neurons)

references.title: Hexameric structure and assembly of the interleukin-6/IL-6 alpha-receptor/gp130 complex.
references.note: human proteins: structure of the IL-6:IL-6Ralpha pair bound to gp130, the hexamer the block draws as IL6:IL6R:IL6ST

references.title: Interleukin-6 triggers the association of its receptor with a possible signal transducer, gp130.
references.note: human IL-6R and gp130: IL-6 triggers the association of IL-6R with gp130, which binds no ligand itself, through their extracellular parts

references.title: A key role for gp130 expressed on peripheral sensory nerves in pathological pain.
references.note: mouse: gp130 deleted in nociceptors only; the IL-6/gp130 complex causes heat hypersensitivity, and the mice have less inflammatory and tumour pain - gp130 is the receptor on the nociceptor

nodes.label: IL6ST
props: CDw130; Interleukin-6 signal transducer; Membrane glycoprotein 130; Oncostatin-M receptor subunit alpha

Functions as a shared signal-transducing subunit not only for IL6 but also for other cytokine receptor complexes, including IL6, LIF, OSM, CNTF, IL11, CTF1, BSF3, MT-RNR2/humanin, CLCF1 and the heterodimeric complex CRLF1-CLCF1. Engages site 2 of CNTF, CLCF1, LIF, and IL-6, and site 3 of IL27 and IL6.

nodes.label: PRKCD
props: Calcium-independent, phospholipid- and diacylglycerol (DAG)-dependent serine/threonine-protein kinase that plays contrasting roles in cell death and cell survival by functioning as a pro-apoptotic protein during DNA damage-induced apoptosis, but acting as an anti-apoptotic protein during cytokine receptor-initiated cell death, is involved in tumor suppression as well as survival of several cancers, is required for oxygen radical production by NADPH oxidase and acts as positive or negative regulator in platelet functional responses. Negatively regulates B cell proliferation and also has an important function in self-antigen induced B cell tolerance induction.
Cytoplasm, Cytoplasm, perinuclear region, Nucleus, Cell membrane, Mitochondrion, Endomembrane system

references.title: Interleukin-6 signaling mediates cartilage degradation and pain in posttraumatic osteoarthritis in a sex-specific manner.
references.note: mouse DMM OA: IL-6 signals through JAK in the dorsal root ganglion to drive pain signalling (the JAK step the block folds into this process; the kinase named downstream is ERK, not PKCdelta)

references.title: Fast modulation of heat-activated ionic current by proinflammatory interleukin 6 in rat sensory neurons.
references.note: rat sensory neurons: IL-6:sIL-6R or the gp130 agonist Hyper-IL-6 potentiates heat current, blocked by the JAK inhibitor AG490 and by rottlerin, a PKCdelta blocker; gp130 mRNA in the neuronal somata

references.title: A key role for gp130 expressed on peripheral sensory nerves in pathological pain.
references.note: mouse nociceptors: the IL-6/gp130 complex acts through PKCdelta activated via Gab1/2 and PI3K, the route drawn as one process

references.title: Protein kinase C delta associates with the interleukin-6 receptor subunit glycoprotein (gp) 130 via Stat3 and enhances Stat3-gp130 interaction.
references.note: cell lines: PKCdelta is recruited to gp130 on IL-6 stimulation (via Stat3) and acts on gp130 Thr-890, so gp130 and PKCdelta meet in IL-6 signalling; the cell types are not named in the abstract

references.title: Interleukin-6 induces nascent protein synthesis in human dorsal root ganglion nociceptors primarily via MNK-eIF4E signaling.
references.note: human DRG explants from organ donors: the IL-6 plus soluble IL-6R pair acts on human TRPV1-positive nociceptors (signalling shown is MNK-eIF4E, not PKCdelta)

nodes.label: TRPV1
props: Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1
Capsaicin receptor; Osm-9-like TRP channel 1; Vanilloid receptor 1

Non-selective calcium permeant cation channel involved in detection of noxious chemical and thermal stimuli. Seems to mediate proton influx and may be involved in intracellular acidosis in nociceptive neurons.
Postsynaptic cell membrane, Cell projection, dendritic spine membrane, Cell membrane

references.title: Sensitization of TRPV1 by protein kinase C in rats with mono-iodoacetate-induced joint pain.
references.note: rat MIA OA knee: TRPV1 of knee-innervating DRG neurons is sensitised by PKC phosphorylation (there PKCepsilon at Ser800), the OA setting for this step

references.title: Interleukin-6 signaling mediates cartilage degradation and pain in posttraumatic osteoarthritis in a sex-specific manner.
references.note: mouse DMM OA: IL-6 raises nociceptive signalling in the DRG, so the IL-6 to channel route operates in OA (the effector named is ERK)

references.title: A key role for gp130 expressed on peripheral sensory nerves in pathological pain.
references.note: mouse nociceptors: IL-6/gp130 acts through PKCdelta and then regulates TRPV1, which is needed for the heat hypersensitivity

references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: Protein kinase C phosphorylation sensitizes but does not activate the capsaicin receptor transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1).
references.note: rat TRPV1, direct sequencing of the phosphorylated sites: PKC phosphorylates Ser800 and Ser502 and sensitises the channel without gating it, which is what the P on TRPV1 stands for

references.title: Fast modulation of heat-activated ionic current by proinflammatory interleukin 6 in rat sensory neurons.
references.note: rat sensory neurons: the heat current potentiated by IL-6:sIL-6R is blocked by the PKCdelta blocker rottlerin, linking PKCdelta to the heat channel
